en.description:
- New Epic Runes: six new runes built to break monster hazards
- Tier II Skin Cards: ten exclusive skins on lenticular cards that change as you tilt them
- Monsters Strike Back: bombs, poison flasks, chains... break them with the matching runes
- Guard Seals: clear 4 or more Defense runes to leave a seal that blocks explosions and poison
- Ally Cards: bring piggies as allies, clear runes to charge them, and tap a card for their Ougi

300 years ago, humanity's last hero fell to the Demon King, and the Skomish Isles have been ruled by his army ever since.
Now a brand-new hero has appeared. It isn't human. It's a little piggy.

[Raise a piggy all your own]
- Hatch it from an egg and give it a name
- Feed it, pet it, clean up its poop. It strolls the farm, digs, naps and chases its ball
- Your piggy remembers you: stay away too long and it sulks, come back and it shows you its diary
- Decorate the farm and the pig house with furniture you can drag anywhere

[Rune-matching battles]
- Drag runes on a 5x5 board and line up 3 or more to clear them
- Mix six marks: Attack, Defense, Heal, Boost, Skill and Ultimate
- Collect and upgrade 40+ runes and build your own tactics
- Runes awaken at Lv.5 and send electricity across the board when cleared; Star Cores fire automatically when full
- Monsters make trouble on the board: break bombs, chains and poison flasks with the matching runes
- Clear Ultimate runes to unleash Ultimates like Meteor Shower, Giant Pig Descends and Rainbow Beam
- Bring ally piggies, clear runes to charge them, and tap a card for their Ougi

[Adventure]
- Blossom Plateau Defense: monsters attack in waves while your piggies fight back with all they've got
- Shipwreck: walk down to the bottom of the ship as the water keeps rising, and submerged runes can't be used
- Explore the world map freely and uncover the secret the human hero left behind
- Climb the Endless Tower as high as you can

[Evolution]
- At Lv.10 your piggy evolves, and what it becomes depends on how you raise it
- Ten forms to discover, then six Lv.50 evolutions (Hero, Mecha, Ninja, Angel, Berserker, Summoner), each with an epic Ougi
- Draw piggy shards to collect every piggy, raise their stars and swap your lead piggy anytime

[Apple Watch]
- Your piggy lives on your wrist too: pet it, feed it, or turn the Digital Crown to give it a back scratch
- Walk with your piggy: it picks up coins along the way, and reaching your daily step goal opens a treasure chest
- Mini-games on the watch: Catch Food, Cup Game and Piggy Race
- Breathe with your piggy, get gentle water reminders, and check fullness and mood right on your watch face
- Your watch and iPhone share the same piggy, gold and progress

[And more]
- FoodPig delivery, Gomoku, Food Stack and the card game Snort
- Play with friends nearby over Wi-Fi
- Daily quests and login bonuses
- Play without an internet connection
- "Remove Ads" removes ads and unlocks Auto Match and hosting Wi-Fi rooms

[Remove Ads monthly subscription]
- Renews automatically every month; price as shown in the App Store
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://piggyhero-public-7aa26e.gitlab.io/privacy/
en.releaseNotes:
- Set sail on a raft: Repair the broken raft and awaken the Compass. Sail freely across the endless sea with one finger; go faster with the wind and slower against it
- Find three gems: Follow the Compass to complete quests and challenge guardian sea monsters to open the way to the Sunken City
- Sunken City: Explore 12 new stages in the depths! Light ancient beacons to weaken monsters and face the Big Boss, Stone Guardian
- Sea fishing: Charge your cast and tug against fish. Collect 12 fish species, plus treasure maps, messages in bottles and legendary sea monsters
- The merchant opens shop: The raccoon buys materials and refreshes a limited stock of goods every three hours
- Piggy is smaller in battle and bosses look more imposing; new disruption Rune: Lights-Out Jellyfish
en.subtitle: Raise a Piggy, Match Runes

ja.description:
・【新エピックルーン】モンスターの妨害を破る6種の新ルーン
・【二階限定スキンカード】限定スキン10種。傾けると絵が変わるレンチキュラーカード
・【モンスターの妨害】爆弾、毒瓶、鎖……対応するルーンで壊そう
・【守護印】防御ルーンを4個以上消すと、爆発と毒を防ぐ守護印が残る
・【仲間カード】こぶたを仲間に連れて、ルーンを消してチャージ。カードをタップで奥義

三百年前、人類最後の英雄が魔王に敗れ、スコミッシュ諸島はそれ以来、魔王軍に支配されてきた。
そして今、新たな英雄があらわれた——人間ではない、一匹のこぶたが。

【あなただけのこぶたを育てよう】
・たまごからかえして、名前をつけよう
・ごはん、なでなで、うんちのお掃除。こぶたは農場をおさんぽしたり、土を掘ったり、お昼寝したり
・こぶたはあなたを覚えている：長く来ないとすねちゃうし、帰ってくると日記を見せてくれる
・家具を買って農場とブタ小屋を好きなように飾ろう

【ルーンパズルバトル】
・5×5 の盤面でルーンをドラッグ、3つ以上つながると消える
・攻撃、防御、回復、強化、テクニック、必殺技。6種類のマークを自由に組み合わせ
・40種以上のルーンを集めて強化し、あなただけの戦術を
・ルーンはLv.5で覚醒し、消すと電流が盤面を駆け抜ける。星の核は満タンで自動発動
・モンスターが盤面でいたずら：爆弾・鎖・毒瓶は対応するルーンで壊そう
・必殺ルーンを消して必殺技を発動：流星群、巨大ぶた降臨、レインボービームなど
・仲間のこぶたを連れて、ルーンを消してチャージ。カードをタップで仲間の奥義

【冒険】
・花咲く台地の防衛戦：モンスターが波状に襲来し、こぶたたちが力を合わせて迎え撃つ
・座礁した船：船底へ向かうほど水位が上がり、水に浸かったルーンは使えなくなる
・ワールドマップを自由に探検して、人間の英雄が残した秘密を解き明かそう
・無限の塔：どこまで登れるか挑戦

【進化】
・Lv.10 で進化。何になるかはふだんの育て方しだい
・10種類の姿、Lv.50 でさらにヒーロー、メカ、忍者、天使、バーサーカー、召喚師の6種類に。それぞれ迫力の奥義つき
・こぶたのかけらを集めて全員をコレクション。星を上げて強化し、メインのこぶたはいつでも交換

【Apple Watch】
・こぶたは手首にも：なでて、ごはんをあげて、デジタルクラウンで背中をかいてあげよう
・いっしょにおさんぽ：歩くとゴールドを拾い、毎日の歩数目標を達成すると宝箱が開く
・ウォッチのミニゲーム：ごはんキャッチ、おわんあて、こぶたレース
・こぶたと深呼吸、お水リマインダー、文字盤で満腹度ときげんをチェック
・ウォッチとiPhoneは同じこぶた。ゴールドも進み具合もいっしょ

【ほかにも】
・FoodPig のバイト、五目並べ、フード積み上げ、カードゲーム Snort
・近くの友だちと Wi-Fi でいっしょに遊べる
・デイリークエストとログインボーナス
・オフラインでも遊べる
・「広告削除」で広告がなくなり、オートや Wi-Fi ルーム作成も使える

【広告削除 月額サブスクリプション】
・毎月自動更新。価格は App Store の表示に準じます
・購入確定時に Apple アカウントに請求されます。現在の期間が終わる 24 時間前までに自動更新をオフにしない限り、自動的に更新されます
・iPhone の「設定」→ ユーザー名 →「サブスクリプション」で管理・解約できます
・利用規約（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
・プライバシーポリシー：https://piggyhero-public-7aa26e.gitlab.io/privacy/
ja.releaseNotes:
・【いかだで出航】壊れたいかだを直し、羅針盤を目覚めさせよう。果てしない海を指一本で自由に航海。追い風で速く、向かい風でゆっくり進む
・【3つの宝石を探そう】羅針盤に従ってクエストをこなし、守護する海の怪物に挑んで、沈んだ都への入口を開こう
・【沈んだ都】新たな12ステージで深部へ！古代の灯台に火をともし、モンスターを弱めて、大ボス「石像の守衛」に挑もう
・【海釣り】力をためて竿を投げ、魚と綱引き！12種類の魚を集めよう。宝の地図や瓶の手紙、伝説の海の怪物も登場
・【商人が開店】アライグマが素材を買い取り、3時間ごとに数量限定の商品を入れ替える
・バトル中のこぶたが小さくなり、ボスの迫力がアップ。新たな妨害ルーン「消灯クラゲ」も登場

versionHistory.releaseNotes: ・English and Japanese are now available ・Wi-Fi play finds nearby friends automatically, no need to type an address ・New mini game "Snort": a card game for 2 to 4 players with AI piggies or friends (the card board on the pig house wall) ・Tap the round window in the pig house to watch the animals and scenery outside ・For Wi-Fi play, only the host needs VIP. Friends can join for free ・Adjusted adventure difficulty so the third map no longer jumps in difficulty ・Fixed Zhuyin input when naming your piggy

- Now available in 15 languages
- New Apple Watch app: pet and feed your piggy, walk together to find coins, play mini-games and more
- Ad privacy settings for players in Europe
- Balance adjustments and bug fixes

- New: Piggy Walk! Head out with your phone and your piggy turns your real neighborhood into a piggy-world map
- Shops, stations and schools nearby become piggy places, and hidden hot springs and caves wait to be found
- Meet monsters and map bosses, pick veggies, and build your piggy's home with its own garden
- Three new evolutions: Angel, Berserker and Summoner piggies, each with an epic Ougi
- Evolution cards: every evolution flips open its own card, and you can watch it again anytime
- New starter piggies: Saddleback Piggy, Baby Boar and Curly Piggy join the hatch
- New story: beat the big boss of Rainbow Falls - what is hidden behind the waterfall?
- New notice board and loading screens
- Balance adjustments and bug fixes

- New level: Blossom Plateau Defense. A brand-new way to play: monsters march in wave after wave while your piggies fight back with all they've got
- New map: Shipwreck, with a new modifier, Submerged. 12 stages heading down to the bottom of the ship: the deeper you go, the higher the water, and runes under water can't move!
- Labyrinth Gems: 5 gems sit beside the board. Clear that row's runes to charge them, and they fire automatically when full
- Ally Cards: bring collected piggies as allies, clear runes in their column to charge them, and tap a card to unleash their Ougi
- Draw Piggies: spend coins or Piggy Tickets to draw piggy shards. Collect enough to unlock new piggies and raise their stars, swap your lead piggy anytime, and see their exclusive cards in the Collection
- Awakened Runes: runes awaken at Lv.5 for stronger attacks and dazzling effects
- Balance adjustments and bug fixes

- New Epic Runes: Demolisher, War Cry, Magnet Snout, Rewind Clock, Iron Fortress and Pure Fountain, six new runes built to break monster hazards
- Tier II Skin Cards: ten new skins, unlocked with shards from Tier II bosses. Skin cards are lenticular, so tilting them shows a different scene, and a worn skin changes your piggy on the farm, in the pig house and in battle
- Monsters Strike Back: monsters drop bombs, poison flasks, chains, armor cores, curses and drainers on the board. Clear runes of the matching tag next to them to break them. Every Tier II monster places them
- Guard Seals: clearing 4 or more Defense runes at once leaves a Guard Seal that blocks explosions and poison. Many runes and ally cards can break hazards too
- Lighthouse Captain: defend Blossom Plateau to collect the old pig's exclusive skin
- New furniture: basketball hoop, trampoline, sandbox, flower bed and carrot patch. Birds, butterflies and rabbits now visit the farm
- More room on the farm and in the pig house, and a brighter farm background
- Balance changes and bug fixes

- Set sail on a raft: Repair the broken raft and awaken the Compass. Sail freely across the endless sea with one finger; go faster with the wind and slower against it
- Find three gems: Follow the Compass to complete quests and challenge guardian sea monsters to open the way to the Sunken City
- Sunken City: Explore 12 new stages in the depths! Light ancient beacons to weaken monsters and face the Big Boss, Stone Guardian
- Sea fishing: Charge your cast and tug against fish. Collect 12 fish species, plus treasure maps, messages in bottles and legendary sea monsters
- The merchant opens shop: The raccoon buys materials and refreshes a limited stock of goods every three hours
- Piggy is smaller in battle and bosses look more imposing; new disruption Rune: Lights-Out Jellyfish
